speaker: Mr David Hoe
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (a) whether the Police will implement multi-language selection and support for the ScamShield helpline; (b) whether multilingual outreach materials on ScamShield will be made available at community nodes; and (c) if so, what are the roll-out timeline and KPIs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Today, members of the public who call the ScamShield helpline are first assisted by the Interactive Voice Response System, which provides automated responses for simpler queries in English.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Currently, however, if the caller chooses to speak to an operator, the operator will converse in the caller's preferred language if the operator is able to, or he can also transfer the call to another available operator who is able to do so.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
text: However, I seek Members' understanding that this is not always possible, such as during peak hours or at night, when there are fewer operators online.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The Police also regularly issue multilingual materials to educate the public on scams and the ScamShield suite of anti-scam resources.

speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
text: The resource guide is also being disseminated through community partners and made available through all our Neighbourhood Police Centres and on the ScamShield website.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: I am particularly heartened that we will consider four languages for our seniors because this is something that my Clementi residents have reached out to me about.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: When they called the ScamShield hotline, everything was in English.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: The first one, I am heartened to know that it is going to be in 2026, but could we have a specific deadline for when we will we see this rolled out.

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: The second question is, from the interim period from now till then, if our seniors have clarifications whether a particular call is a scam call, could we share what could we do about it for our seniors?

speaker: Mr David Hoe (Jurong East-Bukit Batok)
text: Could we consider having a senior mode, because sometimes, they tell me, "David, you talk too fast." So, in the same way, whether a senior mode will allow for them to click a particular number and for that operator to speak slightly slower.

speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
text: In particular, he is concerned at heart for our seniors.
